rows.name: MetamapCompositionError.constructor
facts: Rust checks all shard schema/identity prerequisites, then merges relation references, entities, mappings and authorities in original phase/insertion order. It returns first-source handles; SDK retains original caller objects and produces fresh arrays. Composition validates no graph and grants no admission or authorization.

All 36 frozen original composition controls and both unchanged original composition cases pass at the focused candidate. Six native regressions and Clippy pass. The installed consumer compiles/executes cross-shard merge/conflict behavior and compares function/options/error declarations in both assignability directions.

Original stable-value equivalence preserves locale-equal distinct Unicode key order. Native ordered JSON and the pinned ICU4X collator reproduce both canonical-equivalent and ignorable-key conflict controls, integer-index ordering, deep object reorder, array significance and negative-zero equivalence. The runtime locale is a transport observation, not a native trust grant.

Original composed documents retain own undefined label/revision properties. Typed optional fields are omitted only in the native snapshot; caller properties remain intact. Unknown or mandatory undefined fields/metadata are refused instead of silently accepted. The reference permits additional JavaScript behavior that remains incomplete.

The current digest refresh passes 161 portable Rust tests, Clippy, 29 installed negative type controls, 11 pack/context, 18 graph and three composition declaration comparisons with explicit public registry substitution. All 105 digest/UTF-16, 342 pack/file, 35 registry, 45 graph-query, 36 composition and one inherited-factory controls, 472 validation controls and 101 unchanged original cases pass. Finite evidence leaves complete accepted-domain, package and platform parity unresolved.

The current reporting refresh passes 165 portable Rust tests, Clippy, 34 installed negative type controls, 11 pack/context, 18 graph, three composition and nine reporting declaration comparisons with explicit public registry substitution. All 60 diff/report, 105 digest/UTF-16, 342 pack/file, 35 registry, 45 graph-query, 36 composition and one inherited-factory controls, 472 validation controls and 102 unchanged original cases pass.
